INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

2. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

5. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.

6. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.

9. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
